amendments.text:
The standard atmosphere shall be based upon the following

assumptions: (a) The air is a dry perfect gas. (b) The temperature at sea level is 59° F. (c) The pressure at sea level is 29.92 inches Hg. (d) The temperature gradient from sea level to the altitude at which the temperature becomes -67° F. is -0.003566° F. per foot and zero there above. (e) The density at sea level under the above conditions is 0.002378 lbs. sec.2/ft4.
